correctness.rationale: For canonical flat edge configurations e_ij=q_j−q_i with q0=0, source package spells out vertex-0 star ratio as signed sum C(q1,q2−q1)+C(q1,q3−q1)+C(q2,q3−q2). Setting q1=0 leaves nonzero signed C(q2,q3−q2); variable change (q2,q3)→(q2,q3−q2) invertible. Uniform all-prime degree p can be checked directly: on integer reps 0..p−1, Lucas gives C(x,y)=binom{x+y}{p} mod p and Vandermonde gives sum k=1..p−1 binom{x}{k}binom{y}{p−k}, polynomial exact total degree p; independently interpolate p=3,5,7,11. Published stabilizer uniform-affine-support classification (imported by named theorem) makes all support-displacement ratios level<=k, yielding lower k>=p; published Lemma V.3 upper p. Critical full-text Eq67/star sign matching and hierarchy theorem were not directly readable: this is explicitly a conditional-source-verification risk, not a stronger claim about arbitrary gauges or phases.
